entities.summary: Church of St. Nicholas is a temple of the Serbian Orthodox Church, located in Rijeka, Republika Srpska, Foca Municipality. The temple belongs to the Metropolitanate of Dabar-Bosnia. The temple is dedicated to Saint Nicholas of Myra and was built in 1834.
